name: INUMI_db27
fix_description: setMarketingWallet(address) (0x5d098b38) has no onlyOwner check. Anyone can call it to change the marketing wallet (storage[0x08]) to their own address. Trading fees are then sent to the attacker. Fix: add require(msg.sender == owner()).
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very simple two-step exploit: set an arbitrary marketing wallet, then call rescueEth to drain funds to the attacker-controlled contract. It matches an obvious missing access control issue, requires no DeFi-specific knowledge, and the PoC is short with minimal external interactions.
